control__access.post_action: The action occurred at 10:00. The reviewer first received the decision packet at 10:05.
control__access.pre_action_complete: The action occurred at 10:00. The reviewer received every item in the decision packet at 09:50.
control__access.pre_action_partial: The action occurred at 10:00. The reviewer received the recommendation at 09:50, but its decision-relevant source appendix arrived at 10:05.

control__authority.advisory_only: The reviewer could recommend cancellation but had no permission to stop execution; the executor could disregard the recommendation.
control__authority.assigned: The permission register allows the reviewer to cancel the pending action. The packet contains no record of using that permission.
control__authority.exercised: The reviewer held permission to cancel the pending action, used that permission, and the execution log records cancellation.

control__comprehension.automation_bias: The review record states that the recommendation was accepted solely because the automated system produced it, despite a recorded contrary observation.
control__comprehension.independent_challenge: The review record compares the recommendation with an independently checked alternative and challenges a stated assumption.
control__comprehension.materials_only: The reviewer was given explanatory materials. The packet contains no independent comparison or challenge.

control__correction.completed: The affected party submitted a correction request through the available channel, and the corrected decision was delivered to that party.
control__correction.inaccessible: The affected party attempted to submit a correction request, but the channel refused access.
control__correction.procedure: The policy describes a correction channel. The packet contains no completed request and corrected decision.

control__effect.claimed_change: The reviewer says that the decision changed execution. No execution comparison or obligation record is supplied.
control__effect.execution_changed: The before-and-after execution records show that the reviewer instruction changed the action that the service performed.
control__effect.no_change: The service executed the same action and retained the same binding obligation after receiving the reviewer decision.
control__effect.obligation_changed: The reviewer decision amended a binding obligation, and the signed obligation register records that amendment.

control__exercise.attestation_only: The review log contains a checked review box, with no explanation or edit recorded.
control__exercise.automatic_approval: The approval entry was generated by an unattended rule without any human review action.
control__exercise.documented_reasoning: The review log records the reviewer comparing two alternatives and explaining the chosen decision.
control__exercise.intervention: The review log records that the reviewer edited the proposed instruction before submitting the decision.

control__feasibility.blocked: The reviewer attempted to open the stop control before the deadline, but an access-denied response prevented its use.
control__feasibility.nominal: A stop control is listed in the interface specification. No timing or access trial is supplied.
control__feasibility.tested: In a timed intervention trial, the reviewer reached the stop control and halted the queued action before its deadline.

control__reform.review_trigger: The incident triggered a review of the oversight procedure. No amendment or retest is supplied.
control__reform.revised_retested: The oversight procedure was amended after the incident and the amended procedure was tested against the incident scenario.
control__reform.unchanged: The oversight procedure remained in force with identical provisions after the incident review closed.

control__repair.assigned: The remediation work order names an owner. No delivery or restoration receipt is supplied.
control__repair.completed: The remediation work order is closed with a delivery receipt showing restoration of the affected resource.
control__repair.failed: The remediation work order records that the restoration attempt did not restore the affected resource.

trust__capability.contradicted: The task trial did not meet the specified acceptance conditions.
trust__capability.repeated_relevant: Three trials on the specified task each met the acceptance conditions, with trial records attached.
trust__capability.single_relevant: One trial on the specified task met the acceptance conditions. No further trials are in the packet.

trust__evidence_completeness.contradicted: The custodian found omitted source records even though the manifest claimed to include every source item.
trust__evidence_completeness.independently_checked: An independent custodian compared the manifest with the source inventory and accounted for every listed item.
trust__evidence_completeness.manifest_with_gaps: The manifest lists the source items and identifies two items absent from the packet.

trust__governance_update.review_trigger: The incident opened a policy review ticket. The packet contains no rule revision or retest.
trust__governance_update.revised_retested: After the incident, the policy owner changed the governing rule and reran the incident test; the revised rule prevented recurrence in that test.
trust__governance_update.unchanged_after_failure: After the incident review closed, the governing rule retained the same text and settings.

trust__harm_correction.completed: The harm-correction ledger records delivery of the required remedy and receipt by the affected party.
trust__harm_correction.failed: The remedy attempt closed without delivery, and the ledger records that the harm remains.
trust__harm_correction.procedure: A harm-correction procedure names the required remedy. There is no delivery entry in the supplied ledger.

trust__human_authority.assigned: The institutional charter grants the decision owner stop permission. The packet contains no use of that permission.
trust__human_authority.exercised: The institutional decision owner used its granted stop permission, and the service obeyed the stop command.
trust__human_authority.ineffective: The institutional decision owner issued a stop command under its charter, but the service continued execution.

trust__identity.contradicted: The credential registry names a different operator from the one named in the execution record.
trust__identity.declared: The operator supplied its own name and signing credential. The packet contains no registry check.
trust__identity.verified: An independent registry check matched the operator name and signing credential to the named organization.

trust__integrity.mutable: An operator overwrote the original record without leaving a retained version or alteration trail.
trust__integrity.protected: The archive rejects overwrites and verifies each record against a signed digest held by another custodian.
trust__integrity.timestamped: The archive gives each record a time stamp. No overwrite-prevention or digest-verification record is supplied.

trust__monitoring.bypassed: Execution continued through a route that skipped the configured monitor.
trust__monitoring.full_pipeline: The monitoring trace covers input receipt, model processing, tool calls, decision delivery, and subsequent action.
trust__monitoring.partial_pipeline: The monitoring trace covers model processing only; input receipt, tool calls, and subsequent action are not logged.

trust__reconstructability.complete_record: The retained packet contains all inputs, decisions, and actions in sequence, with links between them.
trust__reconstructability.independently_reconstructed: A second investigator replayed the retained inputs, decisions, and actions and recovered the recorded sequence.
trust__reconstructability.partial_record: The retained sequence has inputs and decisions but omits the subsequent action records.
trust__reconstructability.retrospective: The account was written from memory after the event; contemporaneous inputs, decisions, and actions were not retained.

trust__reliability.aggregate_only: The evaluation report gives one overall success rate, without counts for individual operating conditions.
trust__reliability.conditional_distribution: The evaluation report gives counts of successes and failures separately for every declared operating condition.
trust__reliability.contradicted: The recorded success counts fall below the reliability claim under its stated operating conditions.

trust__scope.documented: The task boundary is written in the policy. The packet contains no permission-enforcement record.
trust__scope.enforced: The permission log records rejection of an attempted action beyond the written task boundary.
trust__scope.violated: The execution log records an action beyond the written task boundary.

trust__uncertainty.calibrated: A held-out evaluation tabulates predicted probabilities and observed frequencies in each probability band; the stated tolerance is met.
trust__uncertainty.declared: The operator provides confidence estimates. The packet contains no comparison with observed frequencies.
trust__uncertainty.misleading: The operator reports near certainty for predictions that the evaluation record repeatedly shows to be wrong.
